description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that blends Express simplicity, Fastify performance, and AI‑driven edge‑ready routing.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages AI‑generated routing tables that auto‑optimize for edge locations, delivers native WebAssembly support, and ships with zero runtime dependencies—giving developers the speed of Fastify, the ergonomics of Express, and the future‑proof AI/edge capabilities that 2026 projects demand.
download_hooks: Blazing‑fast cold‑start < 5 ms on Cloudflare Workers and AWS Lambda.
AI‑driven route generation cuts boilerplate by up to 80 %.
Zero‑dependency bundle keeps your lambda size under 50 KB.
Full TypeScript support with strict type‑safe middleware APIs.
Built‑in observability hooks export to OpenTelemetry with one line.
Seamless WebAssembly integration for compute‑heavy endpoints.
